Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the period below.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2026 (Reiwa 8) through January 15, 2027 (Reiwa 9)

【Changes During Closure】

• Library browsing, book checkouts, and returns at the Children's Library will not be available.

• If you have reserved materials to pick up at the Children's Library, please collect them at Hanno City Library instead.

• The outdoor book return box will remain available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
